osp.agentSheet.detail.continue: Answer it on the form. Ticking "continue" also states that your sales information is included and that you have paid your fees or arranged a payment plan.
osp.agentSheet.detail.services: Answer it on the form: USDA NOP, plus any other programme you sell under (for example US-Canada equivalency for Canadian buyers). Each box checked may add a fee.
osp.agentSheet.detail.production_partner: Answer it on the form. It applies only if at least 75% of your certified sales go to one certified company that pays your fees, as the agent's fee schedule defines it.
osp.agentSheet.detail.signature_authoriz: Signed and dated on the agent's form by someone authorized to sign for the operation{name, select, none {} other {, usually the responsible person ({name})}}.
osp.agentSheet.detail.land_not_compared: New land is checked once this year's update creates a new plan version. Until then, list any land you added since your last renewal on the form yourself.
farm.form.contactPerson.label: Responsible person
farm.form.contactPerson.helpText: The person responsible for the operation, named on your renewal packet and as the signer of your annual update (7 CFR 205.401(b)). Never shown to buyers.
osp.agentSheet.detail.sales_not_over: Calendar {year} is not over yet, so there is no figure to copy. Set the 12 months your agent asks for on your annual update above.
osp.agentSheet.detail.renewal_date_value: {agent} assigned your operation the renewal date {date}. The form and your fees are due before it, and it sets the 12 months of sales Step 6 asks for.
osp.agentSheet.detail.sales_set_publishe: Set the sales period on your annual update above first. For a renewal on {date}, {agent}'s fee schedule asks for sales from {start} to {end}.
osp.agentSheet.detail.sales_set_period: Set the sales period on your annual update above first. {agent} asks for its own 12 months: October to September for a January 1 renewal, the calendar year for an April 1 renewal. Record your renewal date above to see yours.
osp.agentSheet.detail.sales_period_publi: For a renewal on {date}, {agent}'s fee schedule asks for {start} to {end}.
osp.agentSheet.detail.sales_agent_period: {start} to {end}, the months {agent}'s fee schedule gives a renewal on {date}
osp.agentSheet.item.surrender_date: Date you no longer need certification
osp.agentSheet.step.orgb88: Crop Update (ORGB88), only if your crops change
osp.agentSheet.step.2516: Site Update Information (AGR 2516), only if a site changes
osp.agentSheet.detail.ccof_due: Submit the contract and pay your invoice by {due}: online, through {portal}, by mail or by phone ({phone}). {withdrawBy} is the last day to withdraw without owing next year's fees; after it the agent may send an overdue notice and a ${lateFee} late fee.
osp.agentSheet.detail.ccof_changes_appro: The agent asks for changes to your plan when they happen, not at the inspection, and approves them before you put them in place. New parcels and facilities are reviewed before they can be inspected.
osp.agentSheet.detail.ccof_continue_or_s: Answer it on the form: continue (paying the invoice or having arranged a payment plan), or surrender. Surrendering after {withdrawBy} leaves the fees already accrued.
osp.agentSheet.detail.ccof_no_update_mea: The agent reads a contract with no update indicated as "no changes have occurred".
osp.agentSheet.detail.ccof_osp_update: Your annual update lists {additions, plural, one {# addition} other {# additions}} and {deletions, plural, one {# deletion} other {# deletions}}{info, select, yes {, and changes to the application information} other {}}. If your plan changed, choose "needs to be updated" and send the updates to {email} or {portal}.
osp.agentSheet.detail.surrender_only: Only if you are surrendering certification.
osp.agentSheet.detail.ccof_terms: Accepting the contract agrees to its eight terms: you monitor your plan every year, what you send is true, you are bound by the agent's manuals and its Standards of Behavior, you pay its fees, you keep to the standards and its policies, you may sign for the operation, and you agree to its Terms of Use and Privacy Policy. Read them on the form.
osp.agentSheet.detail.ccof_accept_terms: Tick it on the form after reading the terms. Signing your annual update in Trazo is not this acceptance.
osp.agentSheet.detail.ccof_new_certifica: The agent issues new NOP certificates to every certified operation by the end of January.
osp.agentSheet.detail.crop_update_when: File it only if crops change on parcels already on your Client Profile: for each certified parcel, the crops current or planned within the next 12 months and the acres. Filing it lets the agent update your Client Profile Addendum, and only crops and parcels listed there may be sold as organic. The agent also has an Excel version.
osp.agentSheet.detail.crop_update_date: Date it the day you file it.
osp.agentSheet.detail.crop_update_parcel: No parcel's application says it is already on the agent's certificate with a parcel number.
osp.agentSheet.detail.site_changes_none: No parcel's application says it is already on the agent's certificate with a site number.
osp.agentSheet.detail.crop_update_parcel: From your parcels' applications, with the number the certificate prints. The form asks for acres per crop; Trazo holds each parcel's acres, so split them by crop yourself.
osp.agentSheet.detail.site_changes: From your parcels' applications, with the site number the certificate prints. Compare each with your Certified Operation Profile and write what changes: crops or varieties, acres, and whether the site's total acreage drops. Production or planting records that show the site number and name may be sent instead.
osp.agentSheet.step.2519: Additional Facilities and Third-Parties (AGR 2519), one per facility
osp.agentSheet.detail.facilities_2519_wh: File one for each facility or third party at a different address from your primary certified location: where another operation takes the crop before the buyer, stores it or custom handles it (AGR 2121 J 13, K 1, L 1). It is not for fields.
osp.agentSheet.detail.facilities_2519_no: No facility run by another operation is on file.
osp.agentSheet.detail.facilities_2519_ow: Your own facilities ({names}) need this form only if they are at a different address from your primary certified location. Trazo does not know which are.
osp.agentSheet.detail.facilities_2519_he: From your facility records. Business name: {business}. Cert No: {cert}.
osp.agentSheet.detail.facilities_2519_cr: Crops on the records linked to it: {crops}
osp.agentSheet.detail.facilities_2519_ce: Your record shows certificate {number}: the statement for a certified third party fits. Attach its organic certificate and addendum.
osp.agentSheet.detail.facilities_2519_co: A copy of the certificate is on file in Trazo.
osp.agentSheet.detail.facilities_2519_no: No copy of the certificate is on file in Trazo.
osp.agentSheet.detail.facilities_2519_un: Your record shows no certificate number: the statement for a third party that is not certified fits, with how it is exempt.
osp.agentSheet.detail.facilities_2519_mi: Not recorded: {fields}. Fill it in on the facility, under Off-Farm Handlers.
osp.agentSheet.detail.facilities_2519_ti: You tick the responsibility statement on the form; Trazo does not.
osp.agentSheet.detail.facilities_2519_ex: Any business in the organic supply chain must be certified, apart from narrow exemptions for retail establishments and some handlers of tamper-evident packaged products (§ 205.101). WSDA must be able to verify the exemption.
facility.activityGroup.potentially_exemp: Handling activities that are potentially exempt
facility.activity.transloading: Transloading, combining, or splitting bulk shipments
facility.activity.bulk_storage: Storage of bulk, unpackaged organic products
handler.agr2519.title: For WSDA's facility form (AGR 2519)
handler.agr2519.help: For each facility another operation runs for you: its street address and what happens there. WSDA asks for one form per facility, and the copy sheet fills it from here.
handler.agr2519.exemption: How this third party is exempt from certification
handler.agr2519.exemptionHelp: Asked when no certificate number is recorded. Most businesses in the organic supply chain must be certified (§ 205.101).
osp.agentSheet.detail.wsda_due: Your renewal application and fee are due by {due}. The agent sends both forms: fill in the copies it sent. Each month after {due} adds a ${lateFee} late fee.
osp.agentSheet.detail.wsda_send: You can email the application to {email}, but the fee form and check go by mail: payable to {payee}, {mail} (by courier: {courier}).
osp.agentSheet.detail.cert_no_missing: Not recorded. It is on your certificate from the agent.
osp.agentSheet.detail.wsda_income: Money received in {year, select, none {the last calendar year} other {{year}}} from organic crops, products or services: copy it from your books (year-end packer statements, 1099s).
osp.agentSheet.detail.wsda_income_no_fil: Start this year's annual update to see Trazo's cross-check.
osp.agentSheet.detail.wsda_income_not_ov: Calendar {year} is not over yet. Copy the income received in it from your books once it is.
osp.agentSheet.detail.wsda_income_cross_: As a cross-check, your sales records in Trazo show {amount} invoiced as organic and dated in {year}. Money paid in another year than the sale, and services, make the two differ.
osp.agentSheet.detail.wsda_income_unpric: {count, plural, one {# sale} other {# sales}} in {year} {count, plural, one {has} other {have}} no amount recorded, so there is no cross-check.
osp.agentSheet.detail.wsda_income_no_sal: No sale invoiced as organic is recorded for {year}.
osp.agentSheet.detail.wsda_renewal_fee: From the agent's fee table on the form, by the income above. The table also sets a minimum fee for larger operations.
osp.agentSheet.detail.wsda_late_fee: ${lateFee} for each month after {due}. Leave it blank if you file on time.
osp.agentSheet.detail.wsda_how_sent: Answer it on the form. The fee form and check always go by mail.
osp.agentSheet.detail.wsda_sent_date: Only if you send the application and the fee separately.
osp.agentSheet.detail.acreage_removed: If acreage leaves organic production, include a map of the new boundaries and why it was removed (transferred to another grower, converted to conventional).
osp.agentSheet.introForms: You fill in these forms yourself and file them with the agent: {forms}. Form by form: what Trazo holds for you to copy, and what only you can answer. Nothing here is filed for you.
osp.agentSheet.formSentByAgent: {form} (an earlier published copy; fill in the one the agent sent)
equipment.title: Equipment that contacts organic crops
equipment.subtitle: Each item your plan's equipment table lists: what it is used for, whether it is dedicated to organic production, and whether you own, rent, borrow or custom hire it. For anything shared with non-organic work or brought in, also how it is cleaned before organic use and whether it is rinsed. CCOF, OTCO and WSDA all ask for this table.
equipment.error: The equipment could not be saved
equipment.field.name: Equipment
equipment.field.nameHelp: As your crew calls it, for example "Air-blast sprayer, 300 gal"
equipment.field.ownership: Own, rent, borrow or custom hire?
equipment.field.cleaningMethod: How is it cleaned or purged before organic use?
equipment.field.cleaningMethodHelp: Needed for anything shared with non-organic work or brought in (rented, borrowed, custom hire).
equipment.dedicatedLine.no: Also used on non-organic crops or land
equipment.state.complete: Says everything the equipment table asks.
equipment.missing.dedicated: whether it is dedicated to organic production
equipment.missing.ownership: whether it is owned, rented, borrowed or custom hired
equipment.missing.cleaningMethod: how it is cleaned before organic use
osp.equipment.empty: No equipment is recorded yet. Add each item that contacts your organic crops, seeds, transplants or inputs.
osp.equipment.ownRecords: These are your own statements about your equipment, kept in the equipment register on your farm profile. The cleanings you log as activities are kept separately.
osp.equipment.loadFailed: The equipment register could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.
osp.equipment.forbidden: Only company admins and farm managers can see the equipment register.
season.activities.title: Activities
season.activities.empty: Nothing logged on this season yet.
season.details.title: Details
season.photos.title: Photos
season.publicPage.title: Public page
season.publicPage.live: Live: a scan opens this lot’s page
season.publicPage.notLiveBody: The page goes live when you finish the season. Until then only you can preview it.
season.publicPage.printTip: Print at least 2.5 cm (1 in) wide so phones can scan it.
season.publicPage.unpublishedBody: This season is not published, so a scan opens nothing. Only you can preview it. Publishing is on the Buyer Page.
events.wizard.recordLegend: Everything you log here goes on your certifier record. A section marked “buyer page” also shows on the lot’s public page.
events.multiParcel.unavailableNoSeason: Not listed, no season underway: {names}. Start one from the parcel’s page, or log post-harvest work there.
events.multiParcel.unavailableTwoSeasons: Not listed, two seasons underway: {names}. Log on each one from its season.
events.review.title: Check before you save
events.review.body: This is the record your certifier will read. Fields marked for the buyer page also show on the lot’s public page.
events.review.photos: {count, plural, =0 {No photos} one {# photo} other {# photos}} attached.
events.pest.fields.cropGrowthStageHelp: The crop's stage when you scouted.
osp.ownFacilities.coverage: Run by this operation, under its own certificate (OWN)
osp.ownFacilities.empty: No facility you run yourself is recorded yet. Add your packing shed, cooler or storage with its name and full address.
osp.ownFacilities.field.layoutHelp: A drawing or plan, hand drawn or digital, showing the areas used for organic handling and storage. It goes into your renewal packet with this facility.
osp.ownFacilities.field.name: Facility name
osp.ownFacilities.loadFailed: Your facilities could not be loaded, so this list is not showing them. This is a loading problem, not a statement that you have none. Reload before going on.
osp.ownFacilities.layoutFailed: The facility was saved, but the layout did not upload. Choose the file again and save.
documents.shelfSummaryDocs: {docs, plural, one {# document} other {# documents}} · {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} including earlier versions · {size} on this farm's shelf
documents.shelfSummaryDocsOnly: {docs, plural, one {# document} other {# documents}} · {size} on this farm's shelf
fieldNotes.queue.title: Messages to log · {count}
fieldNotes.queue.help: Pick the parcel each message happened on, then log it. We do not guess the parcel: it is what a certifier follows.
osp.materialsList.category.facility_pest: Pest control in handling and storage facilities
osp.materialsList.facility.type.not_nati: Not a National List type (needs your agent's agreement)
osp.materialsList.facility.wherePlacehol: Where it is used (e.g. dry storage room)
osp.materialsList.facility.fumigationAri: Whether {name} is applied by fumigation or fogging
osp.materialsList.facility.fumigationNo: Not applied by fumigation or fogging
certifierLink.disclosure.summary: The link shows this farm’s full records for the period you pick, including private notes, supplier and sale details, and who changed what.
parcel.fieldHistory.title: Field history
parcel.fieldHistory.subtitle: What grew here each year and what was applied. Your certifier reads the three years before harvest (7 CFR 205.202).
parcel.fieldHistory.coverPlaceholder: e.g. Bell beans + oats alley cover
parcel.fieldHistory.substancesPlaceholde: All inputs applied this year (fertilizers, pesticides, amendments, cover crops)
parcel.fieldHistory.empty: No years recorded yet. Add what grew here and what was applied.
parcel.section.energyHint: Used only to estimate this parcel’s irrigation emissions. Your certifier does not ask for it.
osp.wizard.retiredQuestion: Earlier answer, kept as given. This question was replaced by newer questions in this module that ask it in more detail; answer those.
documents.deleteBlocked.inspectionReport: This file is the report of a recorded inspection. Remove it from the inspection on the Organic System Plan page first.
documents.deleteBlocked.certifierNotice: This file belongs to an item from your certifying agent. Remove it from that item on the Organic System Plan page first.
osp.inspections.title: Certifier inspections and notices
osp.inspections.subtitle: Your own copy of each inspection and of each item your certifying agent sends you, with your response. A notice of noncompliance gives a date by which you rebut or correct it and send supporting documents (7 CFR 205.662(a)); the agent then sends a written resolution (205.662(b)).
osp.inspections.emptyNotices: No item from the certifying agent recorded yet.
osp.inspections.addNotice: Add an item from the agent
osp.inspections.uploadFailed: A file could not be uploaded, so the record was not saved. Files that did upload stay linked in the form; save again to send the rest.
osp.inspections.loadFailed: The inspection record could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.
osp.inspections.forbidden: Only company admins and farm managers can see the inspection record.
osp.inspections.ownRecords: These are your own records. Trazo does not receive anything from your certifying agent.
osp.inspections.status.resolved: The agent's resolution notice is on file.
osp.inspections.status.resolutionStatedN: A resolution date is recorded, but the agent's resolution notice is not attached.
osp.inspections.status.respondByPassed: The rebut-or-correct date has passed and no response is recorded.
osp.inspections.status.responseSent: Response recorded. No resolution notice from the agent yet.
osp.inspections.field.reportHelp: The report often arrives weeks after the visit. You can attach it later.
osp.inspections.field.agentLabelHelp: Use the agent's own words, for example "Issue of concern".
osp.inspections.field.letterHelp: A copy of the notice or letter as you received it.
osp.inspections.field.responseText: What you did or why you disagree
osp.inspections.field.responseFilesHelp: Records, photos or letters you sent the agent as supporting documents.
osp.inspections.field.resolutionHelp: Only an attached resolution notice shows the item as resolved.
osp.inspections.unresolvedHint: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} from your certifying agent {count, plural, one {has} other {have}} no resolution notice attached. They are listed under Certifier inspections and notices on this page.
handler.productRows.title: Products for the certificate
handler.productRows.empty: No product rows yet. Your certifier lists each finished product this facility handles for you, with its packaging form and label claim.
handler.productRows.error: The product could not be saved
handler.productRows.statementHelp: CCOF asks for it for each multi-ingredient product, to compare with your label, unless the co-packer is CCOF certified. It is saved in your farm's Documents.
handler.productRows.statementMissing: No ingredient statement is on file for this multi-ingredient product. The plan marks it for review.
